faq_heading: Morgan Creek houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Morgan Creek. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Morgan Creek, South Surrey and White Rock: 45 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Morgan Creek fell from 48 in June to 45 in September (−6.2%), and 15 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.5% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 600 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek?
Morgan Creek also had 39 condos and townhomes listed and 9 sold in September, against 45 houses listed. The Morgan Creek condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Morgan Creek home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

45 houses sold in Morgan Creek with a median price of $1,960,000 (the middle half sold between $1,675,000 and $2,270,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 94.9% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $489 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median lot of 7,137 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 45 houses listed in Morgan Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Morgan Creek had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Morgan Creek from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Morgan Creek over those 4 months, out of 240 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Morgan Creek sell for?
faq.a: 45 houses sold in Morgan Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,960,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.9% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
